items.title: Johnny St. Cyr Interview, 1958-08-27
items.q: He got a fellow by the name of Jimmy Gazan. He was a big contractor around. No, I don't know. So, he had to work for Jimmy Gazan in about 15 years.

ctx.x: He said, because he's here and he's like my own son. We're taking care of this. If anybody else benefit by it, it's me. My mama said, you're right. He said, what you're gonna do if you haven't got enough? He said, I'm gonna get something else to do or something. Get around my old contract that's been working for. Tell him I'm in business.
